responsibility: This autogenerated URL table is the documentation-link companion to gcc/config/nds32/nds32.opt, enumerating GCC manual anchor suffixes for the main NDS32 target switches. It associates documented backend options such as register-set selection, endianness, ISA extensions, 16-bit mode, ISR/cache parameters, architecture selection, constructor/destructor handling, and relaxation with their NDS32 Options manual entries, so generated option information can link users from parsed target options to the correct documentation without redefining the options themselves.
